draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.74, the 3rd-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 1st of 11 at QB. He went 1st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Kyler Murray. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3,633 passing yards in 2023, 4th of 11 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Chicago Bears. 34 career games and 34 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (15 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: passing td 27 (82nd percentile), passing yards 3,942 (78th percentile), approximate value 15 (77th percentile). Weak spots: completion % 58.1% (11th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 quarterback who played: 3,942 passing yards against a median of 1,765, above the norm.
